name: Sarthak Global Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1995, Sarthak Global Ltd is in the business of Share Transfer Agent and Trading of Commodities.
keyPoints:
Services Offered:[1]
Company was initially engaged in Fund based activities, like investment in equity shares of companies. After some time it diversified into short term money market operations like inter corporate deposits, short term and unsecured advance, etc. Company finally started working as a Registrar and Share Transfer Agent and registered with SEBI to serve some companies of Central India

cons: Stock is trading at 5.04 times its book value
Company has low interest coverage ratio.
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of -40.8% over past five years.
Company has a low return on equity of 2.23% over last 3 years.
Earnings include an other income of Rs.1.45 Cr.
